properties.description: Called by release.yml's `container image` job. Composes the index with `imagetools create --dry-run` and checks its platforms BEFORE tagging, creates :<version> and :latest in one call, reads the pushed tag back and checks again, requires :latest to resolve to the same digest, prints "published <image>:<version>" for the cut, and writes image/version/digest/platforms to GITHUB_OUTPUT. A source that is not sha256:<64 hex> is refused before any registry call.
properties.name: docker/publish-index.sh — joins the per-architecture digests into one index, tags <version> and latest, and refuses unless it lists linux/amd64 and linux/arm64
